intro: One clear line from zero to a career you own. Nine steps, four stages. You never have to guess what's next.

steps.title: Set up & mindset
steps.desc: Confirm your equipment, internet, and workspace. Decide this is real.

steps.title: Learn the foundation
steps.desc: Core remote-work skills, tools, and professional etiquette.

steps.title: Build your assets
steps.desc: Resume, portfolio, and profiles that get replies.

steps.title: Apply everywhere
steps.desc: Work the directory. Track every application. Follow up.

steps.title: Interview & negotiate
steps.desc: Prep answers, handle rejection, close the offer.

steps.title: Ace your first week
steps.desc: Onboard like a pro. Your first week is your audition.

steps.title: Systemize your work
steps.desc: SOPs, trackers, and communication that make you reliable.

steps.title: Become indispensable
steps.desc: Anticipate needs. Own outcomes, not tasks.

steps.title: Specialize & automate
steps.desc: Go deeper in your niche, automate the repetitive, raise your rate.
